answer: Social Matters >> Food & Drinks Question ID: 7325 Country: Canada Title: Is meat that was slaughtered by Jews halal or haram? Question: Is meat that was slaughtered by Jews halal or haram? Answer ID: 7325 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1618/1384=B/1429) The present-day Jews are generally atheists; their slaughtered animal is unlawful. However, the Jews who believe in Torah and profess Moses as prophet their slaughtered animal is halal provided they slaughter it by invoking the name of Allah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
